name: strand-select
prompt: A single soft nylon thread being plucked, short bright twang with a gentle decay.

name: strand-select-soft
prompt: A quiet fingertip tap on a taut silk string, muted high pluck.

name: strand-release
prompt: A taut thread softly released, low dull pluck fading quickly.

name: thread-extend
prompt: A strand of yarn sliding over a wooden table edge, short soft rasp.

name: thread-extend-rasp
prompt: A sewing thread drawn quickly across woven fabric, brief textured scrape.

name: thread-retract
prompt: A loose thread pulled back through a needle's eye, short soft zip.

name: thread-retract-soft
prompt: Yarn gently sliding backward off a wooden spool, quiet hushed swish.

name: invalid-move-knock
prompt: A short dull wooden knock with a low muted thud, like tapping a blocked door.

name: spool-reel
prompt: A small wooden fishing reel cranked quickly, clicking ratchet winding in thread.

name: spool-reel-quick
prompt: A quick ratchet click of a hand reel taking up slack line.

name: round-complete-chime
prompt: A gentle ascending sequence of small brass bell chimes with a soft shimmer tail.

name: round-fail-thud
prompt: A soft descending wooden mallet tone ending in a quiet padded thud.

name: ui-click
prompt: A crisp short UI button click, like a small plastic switch snap.

name: ui-click-soft
prompt: A soft muted tap on a small wooden toggle button, gentle click.
